subject: Request: Pause pilot countdown while PO routes (urgent finance escalation)

Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Pause pilot countdown while PO routes (urgent)

Hi Ari —

Quick note following our call this morning. I’m sorry the PO is still routing on your end — I know Erin’s team is doing their best. To avoid the pilot timer expiring while procurement clears, would it be possible for us to pause the 14-day demo countdown for 7 days (starting today) or issue a short 7-day credit so your team can finish the evaluation without interruption?

We’ve done this for similar accounts while finance/PO workflows complete; it’s a light administrative step on our side and avoids losing momentum. If you’re OK, I’ll loop in my manager for sign-off and confirm the exact token/credit amount.

Attached the latest SOW draft you requested for reference.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147

From: Ari Patel <ari@medibase.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Loy <erin.loy@medibase.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pause pilot countdown while PO routes (urgent)

Neha —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. We really appreciate you offering to hold the window. Erin confirmed the PO will route this week but there’s a mandatory two-step approvals queue in finance that could stretch to early next week. A 7-day pause would be ideal — it should buy us the runway to finalize signatures.

Could you confirm what the temporary credit looks like (tokens / usage cap) and whether any billing windows will be affected? Also, I’ll need a short note from Redwood that the timer was paused for procurement reasons for our internal audit.

Thanks,
Ari
Director of Product, Medibase Health
ari@medibase.com

Subject: Fwd: Request: Pause pilot countdown while PO routes (approval request)

David / Marissa —

Heads-up: Medibase (Ari + Erin) has a PO in flight but finance needs a couple more days. Ari asked for a 7-day pause to avoid the demo expiring. They also requested a short written note that the pause is for procurement reasons (audit).

Proposal I recommend: pause the timer for 7 days starting 2027-04-19 and apply a one-time 7-day token allowance equivalent to their current daily usage cap (we estimate ~120k tokens/day based on their activity). No discount, just a temporary pause/credit tied to the account. We’ll record the reason in the account notes and send the audit note to Ari.

Attachments: SOW-Draft-v2.pdf (already shared) and I attached a provisional invoice copy they asked for.

Can I get quick approval? This is time-sensitive — Ari said finance could finish by Friday.

Thanks —
Neha
[Attachment: invoice-provisional.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)]

Approved.

Neha — please apply a 7-day timer pause and issue a one-time 7-day token allowance tied to Medibase’s account (no change to pricing or long-term terms). Add the following note to the account and send to Ari: 

"Redwood Inference paused Medibase Health’s demo countdown for seven (7) days starting 2027-04-19 to accommodate internal procurement/PO routing. This administrative pause does not modify contract terms or pricing and is provided to preserve evaluation continuity."
David — please record the applied credit and update HubSpot (DEAL-2193). Neha — cc me on the email back to Ari with the official note.
